title: Stuff we need
description: When Mojang can't, This mod will.
body:
Do you hate it that you cant mix orange and black dye to make brown dye, or blue and yellow to make green dye, well this mod you can, so insted of finding the biomes, you can make it at home with no risk.

I also added the feature were you can use any stone to make stonecutters, no need to smelt stone, just use andiste, or granite, or whatever.

Have fun :D
